## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Belgium-Luxembourg recorded 2,733K actual service units in 2025, +8.7% compared to 2024 (2,514K).

- Actual 2025 service units were +1.5% above the plan (2,693K).

- Actual 2025 service units are +4.3% above the actual 2019 level (2,620K).
